mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is continuous and always active.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the win rate (positive returns) when FEDFUNDS is in the bottom 25% of its historical distribution is less than 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation spike (CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3 points) signals an imminent monetary policy tightening, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (PAYEMS up and UNRATE down) occurs in more than 50% of cases but SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of those cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (industrial production decline), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of supply shock regime instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflationary pressures, which trigger monetary policy tightening and negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days. The relationship is continuous and always active.
failure_condition: Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 60d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the win rate (negative returns) when CPIAUCSL is in the top 25% of its historical distribution is less than 50%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand across multiple sectors, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST up and RSAFS up) occurs in more than 50% of cases but SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of those cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 235.0), the combination of high interest rates and elevated inflation compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of monetary tightening regime instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
